title: Difference of Squares
summary: Use $a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)$ to subtract squares in one step, multiply two numbers either side of a round number, find the gap between neighbouring squares, and square numbers near a round number.
bigIdeas: $a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)$: a big subtraction becomes an easy multiplication.
Two numbers the same distance from a round number multiply to the round number squared, minus the distance squared.
tips: Two squares next to each other differ by the sum of the numbers: $31^2 - 30^2 = 61$.
Look for a middle number: $37 \times 43$ has middle $40$ and distance $3$.
